title: Fix Kit D3 Diagram Avatar Rendering for All Elements
description: Fix sketchpad Kit app D3 diagram to render avatars in the middle of each shape for all element kinds. Currently designs, tags, types work but others like files don't.
summary: Fixed Kit D3 diagram avatar rendering for all element kinds. Two changes in semio/sketchpad/index.tsx: 1) KitArtifactNode - Added CSS overrides to scale up SVG icons to 40% of container and text initials to text-2xl for file/folder/author/quality/port/concept. 2) kitDiagramTriangleStrategy - Added padding-top 33% to center file icons at triangle centroid. All 105 unit tests pass.
